PC Errata 2018 disc card of [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 24 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/ReflectionsII-Light/large/thisplacecanbealittlerough.gif thisplacecanbealittlerough.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20180124184444/https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/ReflectionsII-Light/large/thisplacecanbealittlerough.gif Internet Archive] (24 January 2018, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 12 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012141907/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/ReflectionsII-Light/large/thisplacecanbealittlerough.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]].
